scene.title: 3D Viewer - DC Fast Charger
scene.description:
FP60 Commercial EV DC Charger 60kW

More details...

  • 7-inch panel: Displays real-time charging status (time, voltage, etc.).
  • Flexible installation: Modular design, indoor/outdoor use, IP54 protection.
  • Smart charging: Dual/multiple outputs, load adjustment/sharing for max efficiency.
  • Connectivity: Data functions, OCPP compatibility, user authentication support.
  • User-friendly: Easy setup, app/IC card payment, works with all market EVs.

config.scene-help-content: Select the hotspots to explore the charger components and features.

hotspots.title: 1. Charger status indicator
hotspots.description: Charger status indicator shows the status of both the A' and 'B' side charging ports.

hotspots.title: 2. Charging Cable
hotspots.description: The Charging connector holder and charging cable. The compatible plug used is 'CCS2'.

hotspots.title: 3. LCD Panel & RFID Chip
hotspots.description: The LCD touch panel, customer usage instructions and the place to tap your RFID card to enable charging.

hotspots.title: 4. Side panel and module slots
hotspots.description: Open the side panel to the side A and side B module slots. Both side panels of the unit can be opened. Please use the included panel key to unlock.

hotspots.title: 5. Door lock
hotspots.description: The door lock is used to secure the charger when not in use. It is also used to prevent unauthorized access to the charger.

scene.title: 3D Viewer - AC Commercial Charger
scene.description:
T-Power AQ7/22 Home Solar Smart EV Charger

More details...

  • Prioritizes renewables with Eco/Eco+/Fast modes.
  • App for remote scheduling/tracking.
  • 4.3-inch LCD, LED indicators, motion display.
  • Connectivity: Data functions, OCPP compatibility, user authentication support.
  • Ethernet/Wi-Fi/4G/Bluetooth, OCPP & safety for sustainable charging.

config.scene-help-content: Use annotations and hotspots to learn about the AC charger.

hotspots.title: 1. Display & Controls
hotspots.description: The LCD screen shows charging status and session information. LED indicators, the RFID reader, and touch buttons let users authenticate and navigate charger menus.

hotspots.title: 2. Radar Sensor
hotspots.description: Located aboive the LCD screen, the radar sensor detects vehicles or obstacles near the charger. It supports safe operation and can trigger lighting or presence-aware behavior.

hotspots.title: 3. Power Connector
hotspots.description: The power connector is where utility or site wiring connects to supply the charger. This is the main electrical feed for AC charging.

hotspots.title: Vehicle Connector
hotspots.description: The vehicle connector is the plug that connects to the EV inlet. On this unit it docks in the holster when not in use.

config.scene-help-content: Follow the installation steps in the footer. Use orbit, zoom, and pan to inspect the charger as you work.
